sentences.text: Police aapko arrest karke chup nahi reh sakti.
Article 22 aur naye BNSS ke under, chaar cheezein zaroori hain.
Unhe batana hoga ki arrest kyun ho raha hai.
Offence bailable hai, toh batana hoga ki aapko bail mil sakti hai.
Aapke kisi rishtedaar ya dost ko batana hoga ki aap kahan ho.
Chaubees ghante ke andar magistrate ke saamne pesh karna hoga.
Aur Article 22 aapko apni pasand ka vakeel karne ka haq deta hai.
Ise save karo, aur us insaan ko bhejo jise kabhi iski zaroorat pad sakti hai.
